supporting_sources.text: A customer-risk product that must answer 'what did we believe on 2026-02-01?' after later reversals needs both as-of transaction-time reconstruction and clear valid-time of risk facts. Missing product requirements include retention policy, who may invalidate, and latency SLOs.
Bi-temporal requirements transfer across implementations; frozen evidence does not mandate a single vendor product.
Adopting a temporal knowledge graph does not remove the need for provenance and citations. Time axes answer when; provenance answers from where and with what authority.
The claim that temporal axes replace sources is false. Systems must keep source identity, citation, and confidence separate from valid-time and transaction-time.

distractor_sources.text: Chunked RAG over chat logs is a complete substitute for bi-temporal edges if reindexed daily.
